title: Ant's CivCraft
description: A modpack with realistic survival for my smp
body: Ant’s CivCraft is a realistic Minecraft civilization survival experience where players build thriving empires, forge alliances, and manage resources to survive and expand. Progress from humble villages to powerful nations using advanced tech, trade, and diplomacy. Every choice shapes your civilization’s destiny in this evolving world of survival and strategy.
